name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

narrative.details:
Hear ye, hear ye!  All heroes are called upon to heed these words!

A call to arms has been issued by the Kingdom of Stormwind!  All able bodied individuals are entreated to take up arms against the dark threat of the Scourge in the northern lands of the Eastern Kingdoms!  Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the Plaguelands!

Heroes of the realm - seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist who has set up his base camp in Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains!
narrative.objectives: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist.  His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Welcome to the Plaguelands, hero.  This is one of the most dangerous frontiers in Azeroth, especially with the looming threat of the Scourge to our north and northeast.  I am glad to hear that the clarion call of duty and service to the greater good did not fall on deaf ears with you!

If you are ready to get your hands dirty, then there is plenty for willing and able heroes to do here on the edge of the Plaguelands.

chain.subtitle: 24 quests from level 50 to 60, 90,895 XP in all.

quests.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
Clear the Way
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Skeletal Flayers and 10 Slavering Ghouls in Sorrow Hill. Return to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
quests.objectiveText: Speak with High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: All Along the Watchtowers
quests.objectiveText: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it. Once all four towers are marked, return the Beac

quests.name: Target: Felstone Field
quests.objectiveText: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there.

quests.name: Scholomance
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Alas, Andorhal
quests.objectiveText: Bring Araj's Phylactery Shard to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Skeletal Fragments
quests.objectiveText: Bring 15 Skeletal Fragments to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
quests.objectiveText: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.

quests.name: Mold Rhymes With...
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Fire Plume Forged
quests.objectiveText: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.

quests.name: Araj's Scarab
quests.objectiveText: Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
quests.objectiveText: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.

quests.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
